title: Ultrahuman offer banner
description: A dark photo banner inset 10px from the window with 16px corners: a light uppercase product name, a huge ultra-condensed italic two-line offer, one line of copy and a white pill. On desktop a thin circular lens floats on the right with three mono HUD readouts in corner-ticked boxes. 90% of the window tall on phones (copy at the bottom), a 2.8:1 strip on desktop.
notes: forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class (white type over a photo)
the headline asks for --ultrahuman-condensed at font-stretch 50%; other themes use their display face
name: ultrahuman-promo

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: small uppercase product name above the headline

props.name: title
props.description: the headline, one string per line (set in a condensed italic, uppercase)

props.name: media
props.description: the photo or video filling the panel (cover); a placeholder when empty

props.name: mediaLabel
props.description: describes the photo for screen readers when the placeholder shows

props.name: readouts
props.description: up to three readouts floating around the circular lens (desktop only)
